findings.finding: Phase-two escape is checked before node read; structural B0/anchor treatment precedes geometry.
Both descendants preserve original context, phase, cursor and count; singleton remains in the same traversal.
Anchor rank already available. Stack context remains alive for synchronous recursive descendants; future asynchronous jobs must own a durable context.
Shared cursor_advances = count_node_visits - query_splits + structural_splits + deferred_skips + anchor_skips + phase_switches. The numeric cursor may move backwards at a phase change.
Anchor skip consumes one work site, zero strict interiors. Deferred B0 skip consumes neither during complement.

limitations: No C++ gate, runtime or complete product qualification in this audit.
No sources outside the three archived files are claimed captured.
Counters/model are different scopes: product count_node_visits counts geometric evaluations only; model node_visits includes structural node visits.
scope: static inspection of three worktree files, no compilation or execution
